functions.description: Classify the intestate heir configuration by counting the surviving descendants and checking whether each descendant is also a child of the surviving spouse.
inputs: The surviving spouse of the decedent, with relationship to the decedent
The surviving descendants of the decedent, with count and whether each is also a child of the surviving spouse
outputs: Heir configuration case label stating whether all surviving descendants are also the spouse's children or some are not
Number of surviving descendants of the decedent

functions.description: Look up the spouse's base dollar amount and balance fraction for an intestate heir configuration under a named UPC edition.
inputs: The intestacy statute edition and its base dollar amounts, i.e. the Uniform Probate Code version in force
Heir configuration case label stating whether all surviving descendants are also the spouse's children or some are not
outputs: Base dollar amount the spouse takes first, in dollars
Fraction of the balance of the estate after the base amount that passes to the spouse

functions.description: Compute the surviving spouse's intestate share as the base dollar amount plus a fraction of the estate balance remaining after the base amount, capped at the whole estate.
inputs: The value of the decedent's net intestate estate in dollars, with currency unit
Base dollar amount the spouse takes first, in dollars
Fraction of the balance of the estate after the base amount that passes to the spouse
outputs: Balance of the estate after the base amount in dollars
Spouse's share of the balance in dollars
Total intestate inheritance of the spouse in dollars

functions.description: Split the estate remaining after the spouse share equally among the surviving descendants and verify that the spouse share and the descendants shares sum to the full estate.
inputs: The value of the decedent's net intestate estate in dollars, with currency unit
Total intestate inheritance of the spouse in dollars
Number of surviving descendants of the decedent
outputs: Amount passing to each surviving descendant in dollars
Total passing to the surviving descendants in dollars
Check that the spouse's share and descendants' shares equal the full estate

functions.description: Compute the surviving spouse's intestate inheritance under a named probate code intestacy edition with base dollar amounts, narrating each step.
inputs: The intestacy statute edition and its base dollar amounts, i.e. the Uniform Probate Code version in force
The value of the decedent's net intestate estate in dollars, with currency unit
The surviving spouse of the decedent, with relationship to the decedent
The surviving descendants of the decedent, with count and whether each is also a child of the surviving spouse
The heir whose inheritance is being asked for, identified as the surviving spouse
outputs: Amount inherited by the surviving spouse in dollars
Explanation of how the spouse inheritance was found, including the edition used

entry_points.text: Under ●1, a man dies without a will, leaving an estate of ●2. He is survived by ●3 and ●4. How much does ●5 inherit?

params.description: The intestacy statute edition and its base dollar amounts, i.e. the Uniform Probate Code version in force
format_examples: the Uniform Probate Code (using its base dollar amounts)
the Uniform Probate Code (1990 text with base amounts)
the Uniform Probate Code (current revision without base amounts)
params.original_value: the Uniform Probate Code (using its base dollar amounts)
params.validity_range: Must be a UPC edition whose spouse rule uses a base dollar amount, since the base amount drives the formula. Editions without a base amount give a different rule and would move the problem to another class. Only applies when the decedent died intestate.

params.description: The value of the decedent's net intestate estate in dollars, with currency unit
params.validity_range: Must be a nonnegative dollar amount. If it is below the base amount the spouse takes the whole estate. If it is zero the spouse receives nothing from the estate.

params.description: The surviving spouse of the decedent, with relationship to the decedent
format_examples: his wife
her husband
his wife of many years
params.validity_range: Exactly one surviving spouse must be present for this rule. If no spouse survives, the spouse share does not apply and the estate passes to descendants or other kindred instead.

params.description: The surviving descendants of the decedent, with count and whether each is also a child of the surviving spouse
format_examples: two children from a prior marriage who are not her children
three children who are all her children
one son from a prior marriage and one daughter shared with his wife
params.original_value: two children from a prior marriage who are not her children
params.validity_range: Count must be a nonnegative integer. Zero descendants moves the rule to parents or other kindred. The case depends on whether all descendants are also the spouse's children: if all are, the spouse takes the whole or a larger share; if some are not, the base-amount rule applies.

params.description: The heir whose inheritance is being asked for, identified as the surviving spouse
format_examples: the wife
the husband
the surviving spouse
params.validity_range: Must refer to the surviving spouse named in the problem. Asking for a descendant's share instead requires computing the remainder after the spouse share, which is a different output of the same class.
